prompt: A photorealistic photo captures the gritty atmosphere of a car repair garage with high-definition clarity and natural lighting. In the center, a mechanic in greasy blue overalls lies on a creeper under a lifted silver sedan, holding a wrench firmly. To the left, another technician in a red shirt wipes oil from his hands with a rag, standing next to a tool chest covered in scattered sockets. In the foreground right, a customer in a business suit looks at a tablet displaying diagnostic results, pointing at the screen while talking to a service advisor in a polo shirt. A black cat sits on a stack of tires in the background left, watching the activity with keen interest. Near the entrance, a delivery person in a brown uniform hands a package to the receptionist behind a glass counter. Oil stains mark the concrete floor, reflecting the overhead fluorescent lights. The background shows shelves stocked with motor oil bottles and hanging hoses. Sharp focus on the mechanic's tools contrasts with the slightly blurred background, emphasizing the depth of the workspace. The image conveys the industrious nature of the garage through realistic textures of metal, rubber, and fabric, capturing a candid moment of professional collaboration and routine maintenance in a detailed and authentic setting.
